Your memory curve
Review
You are here

Pick a flashcard set to see its curve.

The forgetting curve, discovered in 1885 by German psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus, mathematically maps how your brain drops roughly 50% of new data within one hour and up to 70% within a single day.

  • Without review, retention falls quickly in the first day.
  • Each review bumps your curve back up and slows the next drop.
  • Pick a set above to see that set’s curve only.
